produs.after_launch.title: What happens after launch
produs.after_launch.body:
The platform searches for an eligible partner in your area, based on declared skills and availability.
The amount is held in Escrow until execution is confirmed — it is not transferred directly.
You can track your order status anytime from your account.
produs.launch_note: Next step: confirm your address, terms and payment method on the checkout page.
